FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 200
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs and Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/05/2025
Senate Bill 200 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the
Administrative Office of Courts by requiring the office to establish policies and procedures
relating to consolidation of all specialty courts into an accountability court program.

FN-U99CUDX-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 200
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/31/2025
Senate Bill 200 as passed the Senate could increase the administrative obligations of the
Administrative Office of Courts by requiring the office to establish policies and procedures
relating to consolidation of all specialty courts into an accountability court program.
In addition, this bill would require that accountability courts be funded as a separate line item in
the General Fund Appropriations Act.
